recommendation: Develop tailored nutrition plans considering food access limitations
implementation_steps: Develop nutrition plans that account for food access limitations
Provide practical guidance for healthy eating on limited budgets
Support implementation of medically tailored meal programs
Adapt dietary recommendations to available food resources
Educate on maximizing nutritional value of accessible foods
evidence_summary: Dietitian-led tailored nutrition interventions that account for food insecurity have demonstrated improvements in dietary quality, glycemic control, and self-management of chronic conditions among food-insecure populations.
